author: jracer15
body:
Map Name: Mt Blizzard
Gamemode: Walls
Creators: jracer15
Teams: Navy, Yellow, Gray, White

Here is my newest walls map.  It has taken me a while to make this but I'm glad how it turned out.  I'm no Polar_Express or timaueusTestified but I'm proud of what I did accomplish. The only diamonds on the map is in the middle to make it more a fair pvp oriented map.  Hope you guys like it.

Map Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/kutb19oi06eaelp/MtBlizzard.zip?dl=0
YML Pastebin: http://pastebin.com/vPAJLLV5
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/a2RHq\


1.1 Update Includes
  • Nerved the Blizzard Sword
  • Changed it to 1.7
  • Smoothed out a little bit of terrain
  • Fix the empty chests in the middle
  • Fixed the YML Issues

1.2 Updated Includes
  • There are a lot less wolves in the chests
  • Edit the walls drop look
  • Changed the Team Blue to Team Navy
  • Added a map.png

*Please leave feedback, very appreciated!!
